policy: Historical mapping declarations retained when Editor Bridge moved out of core Luda. These names and limits are not test results or qualification evidence. Run the separate add-on tests and bind any reported outcomes to the add-on source revision.

EDIT-09.limits: Provider-specific code-point conversion for Qt/Gecko plus Chromium authoritative selection. Exact live Firefox cases pass except protected input; older Electron non-BMP selections and GTK4 provider limitations remain explicit. Owned-browser code-point read limits and cooperating paragraph UTF-16 mappings are unit-tested; mid-surrogate selection is explicitly unsupported, not normalized into a guessed position.

ERR-01.limits: Unit accumulated-effect classification; completed substeps are not comprehensively enumerated. Known preedit/provider refusal, missing explicit paragraph semantics and final paragraph overflow stop before focus/keys with no input effects. This does not imply that every later-stage rich-editor failure is pre-input.

ERR-05.limits: Bounded repeated-key dispatch counts and cooperating rich-editor segment readback counts, with exact public/error/history projection and actual companion/worker receipt tests. Rich verified_completed counts historical exact text/paragraph/unaffected-mark/caret checks; clipboard publication alone may make the current segment uncertain. Lost receipts and cancellation do not synthesize counts. No application save/commit, automatic replay, or comprehensive other-compound-action support is claimed; see RICH-PROGRESS.md.

ERR-03.limits: Controlled exact HTML value comparison and cooperating-model revalidation prevent a success claim on a same-length concurrent document change. Selection may already have occurred and is conservatively uncertain; application commit and atomicity against later page changes are not established.

DATA-07.limits: Cooperating registered basic ProseMirror paragraphs only: original prefix marks survive text-run merging, unsupported nodes/marks/pending marks are refused, and LF requires explicit paragraph intent. Inserted formatting follows application behavior; these assertions do not support arbitrary contenteditable editors or arbitrary middle-range insertion. Explicitly declared cooperating hard_break leaves have per-action structural/caret/mark verification; legacy and other mixed unsupported nodes refuse. Not generic rich-editor or arbitrary-schema support.

WEB-03.limits: Unit evidence covers cooperating paragraph representation and a single dispatched segment followed by uncertain focus failure without replay. Real independent DOM/model oracles are in the registered owned-rich suite; no general rich-editor formatting or focus-race prevention claim.

PERF-08.limits: Cooperating paragraph operation limits reject excessive segments and known final paragraph overflow before focus/input. This is a bounded rich-text workload assertion, not a memory-pressure benchmark or a general clipboard size qualification.
